items.title: Comparison of two big pro-etale sites with one contained in the other
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for two big pro-etale sites with one contained in the other, the inclusion functors on both the absolute and the relative sites satisfy the criterion for a bigger site, so that there are morphisms of topoi g and f with f composed with g isomorphic to the identity (statement lines 6591-6621). The proof (proof lines 6623-6633) verifies the five conditions of the criterion, using the refinement of pro-etale coverings for condition (a) and the compatibility of fibre products for condition (d). H2: a criterion check with three inputs, written out in full.
